def get_shape(val: Any) ->Optional[List[int]]:

def matmul_flop_jit(inputs: List[Any], outputs: List[Any]) ->Number:
    input_shapes = [get_shape(v) for v in inputs]
    assert len(input_shapes) == 2, input_shapes
    a_shape = input_shapes[0]
    b_shape = input_shapes[1]
    
    assert a_shape[-1] == b_shape[-2] if len(b_shape) >= 2 else a_shape[-1] == b_shape[-1]
    
    if len(a_shape) == 1:
        a_shape = [1] + a_shape
    if len(b_shape) == 1:
        b_shape = b_shape + [1]
    
    batch_dims_a = a_shape[:-2]
    batch_dims_b = b_shape[:-2]
    
    batch_size = 1
    max_len = max(len(batch_dims_a), len(batch_dims_b))
    batch_dims_a = [1] * (max_len - len(batch_dims_a)) + batch_dims_a
    batch_dims_b = [1] * (max_len - len(batch_dims_b)) + batch_dims_b
    
    for da, db in zip(batch_dims_a, batch_dims_b):
        batch_size *= max(da, db)
    
    m = a_shape[-2]
    k = a_shape[-1]
    n = b_shape[-1]
    
    flop = batch_size * m * k * n
    return flop
